$comment: Structural budgets for the feed row-cost harness (issue #1103). Exact counts, not timings: they are deterministic, so they can gate CI. Lower a ceiling when an optimization lands; raising one is a decision to write down in the PR. Bloom 7.31 + react-native-css 3.1.0-rc.0 (inline video on iPhone Safari): text hostNodes 52.125 -> 53.125 because Bloom 7.9.2 gives the avatar placeholder image its own positioned wrapper so it paints above the absolute shape fill on web; linkPreview contextReads 53 -> 55 because react-native-css 3.1.0-rc.0 re-runs an interop component's rule effect after commit (its StrictMode-safe subscription), so the link card's interop Pressable reads its two CSS contexts twice on mount. Bloom 10.7.0 (Alia's live avatar on the Ask Alia button): linkPreview contextReads 55 -> 56 because Bloom's Avatar now also calls useMessages(AGENT_AVATAR_MESSAGES) for its character-face label, a second LocaleContext read on every Avatar even when it draws no character (every avatar row gains one; only linkPreview had no headroom). Bloom can read that catalog only in the character branch and give this back. Bloom 11.1.0: text componentsPerRow 195 -> 196. Comparing the real text-row fiber trees on main 319ab1dd6 and the update (eight rows), each native Image becomes BloomImage + ExpoImage: +1 component per row, with no extra host nodes or requests. Every other ceiling is unchanged. Bloom inline post Markdown: comparing main a686b2525 (Bloom 12.2.0) against the real shared InlineMarkdown renderer adds one component, one theme context read and one hook per post body; quote rows render two bodies. Host nodes, requests and unrelated-row renders are unchanged. Raise only exhausted component ceilings: text 196 -> 197 and quote 266 -> 268. Other ceilings retain their existing headroom. Avatar prefetch removed from PostItem (the row's own Avatar loads the same image in the same commit): every avatar row loses its one request and the hooks of useImagePreload, so requestsPerRow is 0 for every kind, the fling's requests per post visited 1 -> 0, and hooksPerRow drops to the measured values (text 293 -> 272, quote 488 -> 445). Bloom 15.10.1 -> 15.16.0: linkPreview hooksPerRow 331 -> 351 and contextReadsPerRow 56 -> 77. Bisected over published versions: 15.11.0 still fits, 15.14.1 adds +14 hooks / +12 context reads and 15.16.0 +6 / +9 more, all inside the one Bloom LinkPreviewCard (its own source is unchanged since 15.1.0, so the cost comes from the Bloom primitives it renders); no other kind moved and host nodes, components and requests are unchanged. Raised to the measured values; lower them if Bloom trims those primitives. The ⋯ menu is Bloom's DropdownMenu owned by PostHeader (Bloom DropdownMenu directly, no app adapter): the open state is one hook per row (+1 hooksPerRow for every kind; quote renders two headers, so +2 hooks and +2 components). The menu content is lazy and mounts only while open, so nothing else is paid per row. Persistent video handoff: after removing the unused native loading subscription and driving web HLS loading directly from the shared controller, video hooksPerRow 384 -> 414 and contextReadsPerRow 43 -> 44. The persistent PlaybackVideoView adds one component (230 -> 231) and owns the view lease, serialized source replacement and first-frame handoff; shared playback authority keeps presenters from issuing competing commands. Actual host nodes (60.125), renders per mount (2), network requests (0), query observers (0), unrelated-row renders (0) and 200-post fling requests (0) are unchanged. Only these two video ceilings increase; all others stay fixed. Send in Allo (Instagram's paper plane, OxyHQ/Mention#1609): the post action bar gains one Bloom PressableScale. Measured on the text row with the button removed, with the button and no icon, and with the icon: the PressableScale is +21 hooks, +2 context reads and +8 components per row (the same primitive every other action-bar button is), and the Bloom RiSendPlaneLine icon +1 component; host nodes stay inside their ceilings and requests, observers, renders and unrelated-row renders are unchanged. hooksPerRow and contextReadsPerRow are raised to the measured values for every kind, and componentsPerRow for every kind but linkPreview, which had the headroom; the way to give this back is a cheaper PressableScale in Bloom, which every action-bar button would share. Post action bar on Bloom 15.24.0's EngagementBar (PostActions rebuilt; Mention's AnimatedLikeIcon, CountWheel and VotePill deleted): each action is one react-native Pressable with its glyph and, with a count, one Text; the bar resolves paint, count format and haptics once and its actions read one context and hold one state slot; the like's pop and count roll mount only on an accepted press. Measured before/after on the same tree (Bloom 15.22.0 -> 15.24.0), per row, every kind moves the same: components -24 (text 157 -> 133), hooks -65 (text 279 -> 214), context reads -7 (text 33 -> 26), host nodes -1 (text 38.125 -> 37.125), renders per mount 2 -> 1 for every kind but linkPreview (2); requests, observers, unrelated-row renders and fling requests are unchanged. One action at rest under this harness: a PressableScale button was 9 fibers / 21 hook slots / 2 context reads, an EngagementAction is 6 / 11 / 1 (10 of the 11 slots are react-native's Pressable). Every component, hook, context-read and host-node ceiling is lowered to the measured value, including the headroom earlier changes had left. Stored agent avatar adoption (Bloom 15.60.6 -> 15.79.1): AccountAvatar adds one React policy component per author (quote: two), with no hooks, host nodes or copied renderer. AccountAvatarGroup mounts capability subscriptions only for rendered groups with valid stored bot characters, so absent and photo-only groups pay none. The shared photo-error observer is opt-in; ordinary feed photos do not mount it. Bloom 15.79.0 also removes unconditional avatar press-state hooks and native surface-bake subscriptions. Measured on the real row tree with the 15.79.1 package: text hooks 214 -> 210, contexts 26 -> 25, components 133 -> 134; quote hooks 388 -> 380, contexts 43 -> 41, components 206 -> 208. LinkPreview remains at 63 context reads (the shared increased-contrast context offsets the removed avatar context) and hooks 292 -> 288. Lower every hook/context ceiling to these measurements and raise only the one policy-component cost per author; host nodes, requests, observers, renders, isolation and fling limits are unchanged. These structural counts are not device frame-rate measurements. Which-video-plays moved to Bloom's video-playback (Mention's VideoPlaybackContext, video-playback-control and useReferenceVisibility deleted, OxyHQ/Mention#1622): video hooksPerRow +3 and contextReadsPerRow +1, measured per component (eight rows, only VideoPlayer moved). One hook and the one context read are not new work: Mention's jest maps @oxy.so/bloom/screen to test-support/bloomScreen.js, whose useScreenVisible reads no context and holds no slot, so the harness never counted the real ScreenContext read and app-state subscription the device always ran; Bloom's hook imports the real one. The other two are React Compiler: the app's copy compiled its stable callbacks into one memo-cache slot, Bloom source is not compiled, so reportVisibility and claimActive are useCallback slots. Only these two video ceilings increase. Thread hover subscriptions moved from every PostItem to only the thread overlay, while pointer ownership is per mounted instance and released on recycle. On the current real row harness text hooks fall 210 -> 203, video 354 -> 347 and quote 380 -> 366; every non-quote kind drops 7 slots. Host nodes, components, context reads, requests, query observers and unrelated-row renders remain unchanged. A four-row fixture (three thread rows and one standalone) reads the thread store three times instead of eight, and hovering no longer re-renders either PostItem in its thread. These are structural counts, not device frame-rate measurements. Link-preview fixture corrected to the Clarity document DTO with publisher and imageUrl: the real cover adds one host node and two components (42.125 -> 43.125 and 160 -> 162). Other ceilings are unchanged. Bloom 17.6.2 -> 17.8.1 (consolidation phase 3: every family on Bloom's typography): Bloom's LinkPreviewCard now draws its site name, title, description and byline with Bloom Text instead of raw react-native Text, so each reads the theme paint and typography-scope contexts itself. linkPreview hooksPerRow 281 -> 284, contextReadsPerRow 63 -> 74, componentsPerRow 162 -> 171; no other kind moved, and host nodes, requests, observers and renders are unchanged. Raised to the measured values; the way to give this back is a cheaper Bloom Text (one paint read per text), which every Bloom text in a row would share. Bloom 17.8.2 gives most of it back at the root: a Bloom Text without a className is React Native's text node (no react-native-css interop host, which only passed the style through), and native useThemePaint no longer reads the web-only prepaint context. Per Bloom Text on native: 3 components, 3 hooks, 5 context reads -> 1, 0, 2. Measured: linkPreview componentsPerRow 171 -> 165, hooksPerRow 284 -> 275, contextReadsPerRow 74 -> 65; no other kind moved. Lowered to the measured values. Bloom 17.19.3 -> 19.2.0: linkPreview contextReadsPerRow 65 -> 66, one more context read inside the one Bloom LinkPreviewCard (its primitives, not Mention's row); no other kind moved and hooks, components, host nodes, requests, observers and renders are unchanged. Raised to the measured value; lower it if Bloom trims that read. Posts on @oxy.so/bloom-data (one posts store, Mention#feat/bloom-data-posts): a row reads its post with useEntity instead of usePostSelector. Measured against the branch point on the same tree, every PostItem pays +1 context read (the store comes from DataProvider context, so an account switch and a per-request server store reach every reader) and +2 hook slots (the reader that records which fields the row read, and the store lookup; library code is not React-compiled, so these are real slots where the app's compiled usePostSelector folded its callbacks into one memo cache). Quote rows render two posts, so +2 / +4. Components, host nodes, renders per mount, requests, observers, unrelated-row renders and fling requests are unchanged. Only the exhausted ceilings are raised, to the measured values: every contextReadsPerRow, and linkPreview hooksPerRow. VideoPlayer split (a surface handed a player builds none): video componentsPerRow 168 -> 169, the VideoSurface fiber under the memoised dispatcher; it removes the null-sourced spare expo-video player each feed video row built, which on Android is a whole ExoPlayer. Video rows attach a player only inside the feed's preload window (Bloom useViewableNear, a pool of parked players): video contextReadsPerRow 30 -> 31, the viewability context the near read subscribes through. This harness publishes no viewable keys, so it now measures a DETACHED row (the state of every mounted row outside the window): components 157, hooks 327, host nodes 42.125, context reads 31. Measured with the row forced near, an attached row is components 169, hooks 345, host nodes 45.125, context reads 31, renders per mount 1; the other video ceilings stay at the attached cost. Bloom's useViewableNear then reads the screen's visibility and the row's rank as well (a background screen keeps only its on-screen rows' players): video contextReadsPerRow 31 -> 32 and, for an attached row, hooksPerRow 345 -> 349 (detached 331), so the video hooks ceiling 347 -> 349. The language row is the only row (Mention#feat/mention-on-language): PostItem is the row the owner's build already drew behind EXPO_PUBLIC_BLOOM_LANGUAGE_ROW, with the codemod's and the hand pass's language chains inside its embedded pieces, on Bloom's final line (no NativeWind in Bloom). Every ceiling is set to the measured value on this tree. Lower: hooks on every kind (text 203 -> 108, quote 366 -> 244: the row's controller is one compiled hook and its tree is language nodes, not PostHeader/PostActions components), components on every kind but quote, repost, poll and communityNote (text 134 -> 127), host nodes on every kind but quote and repost (text 37.125 -> 36.125). Higher: context reads on every kind but linkPreview (text 26 -> 35, poll 26 -> 54, communityNote 28 -> 62, quote 42 -> 72): each language leaf that paints a colour reads the theme where it is drawn (the language's Painted leaf, and Bloom's createTokenStyles leaves for the pieces that stay React Native), where NativeWind's interop read its CSS contexts; poll and community-note rows hold the most such leaves after their cards moved to the language. Quote host nodes 57.125 -> 62.125 and components 208 -> 230, repost host nodes 36.125 -> 39.125 and components 133 -> 140: the language row's nested quote and repost structure, measured the same on the owner's language row before this branch (62.125 / 225, 39.125 / 139). Renders per mount, requests, observers, isolation and fling are unchanged. Structural counts, not device frame times: the Pixel comparison against the owner's build is the arbiter. Feed-row ports from the owner line (link cards held at their size, row images sized and cached, prefetch, recycle buckets by attachment shape, one header identity per author, no i18n subscription in LiveAvatar or usePostLanguage), measured against this line's head on the same Bloom main packs (23.7.2, language 1.4.0, bloom-data 0.1.2): hooks per row -32 for text (117 -> 85), -65 for quote (262 -> 197), -41 for linkPreview, -33 to -35 elsewhere; context reads -2 (quote -4); components, host nodes, renders, requests and observers unchanged. Every component, hook and context-read ceiling is set to the measured value. Components are one higher than the last ceilings on every kind but repost, poll and communityNote (quote two): Bloom language 1.3.0's press highlight hosts a hover group that takes a press in its own component (PressHighlighted), measured the same on this line's head, which also held 9 more hooks per row for it (text 108 -> 117) before the ports gave them back.
